claims: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight test of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission lifted off at 18:35 CDT on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission lifted off at 23:35 BST on April 1, 2026.
The objective of the Artemis II mission is testing SLS/Orion with crew Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission will last approximately 10 days.
The crew of the Artemis II mission will test life support systems for future lunar exploration.
Coverage of the Artemis II mission is available via NASA TV.
Coverage of the Artemis II mission is available via the NASA app.
Coverage of the Artemis II mission is available via NASA+.
NASA YouTube Channel provides 24/7 streaming coverage of Artemis II mission operations.
In-person viewing of the Artemis II mission is available at Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
